concerns.text: User Story 2 (T008‑T010) depends on the aligned dataset produced in User Story 1 (T007). The constitution requires each user‑story block to be independently shippable and testable end‑to‑end; therefore the current ordering violates the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule.

User Story 3 (T011‑T012) depends on regression artifacts from User Story 2 (T009). This cross‑story dependency means User Story 3 cannot be executed or verified in isolation, breaching the requirement that tasks within a US block form an independently‑shippable unit.
